description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'HardRefCacheLine' that extends 'CacheLine'. It encapsulates a cached value along with load and expiration times, providing a method to retrieve the value.

classes.name: HardRefCacheLine
classes.description: An abstract class representing a cache line that holds a hard reference to a cached value of type V, along with load and expiration times.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the cached value stored in this cache line.
